revisions.description: Lists the files and folders in one folder of a SharePoint document library through Microsoft Graph. The app registration needs the Sites.Read.All or Files.Read.All application permission, or Sites.Selected with a grant on the site.

params.label: Tenant ID
params.helpertext: The Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration
params.name: tenantId

params.label: Client ID
params.helpertext: The Application (client) ID of the app registration
params.name: clientId

params.label: Client Secret
params.helpertext: A client secret of the app registration. The task gets its own app-only Microsoft Graph token with it
params.name: clientSecret

params.label: Site
params.helpertext: The site's URL (any page under the site will do) or its Graph site ID
params.name: site

params.label: Document Library
params.helpertext: The library's name, e.g. Documents. Blank is the site's default library
params.name: library

params.label: Folder
params.helpertext: The folder in the library. Blank is the library's root
params.name: folder

params.label: Output File
params.helpertext: A workspace path to write the listing to as JSON, absolute or relative to /workspace. Needed when the listing is over 3000 bytes
params.name: outputFile

results.description: A JSON array of {name, path, type, size, lastModified, webUrl}, when it fits in a result (3000 bytes); otherwise empty and the listing is in Output File
results.name: files

results.description: How many files and folders the folder holds
results.name: count

results.description: The absolute path of Output File, when set
results.name: outputPath
